output_list.reason: The 'mint' function does not check for overflow when updating the 'totalSupply' and 'balances' variables, which can lead to an overflow and allow an attacker to mint unlimited tokens.
The 'transfer' function does not check if the contract is frozen, allowing transfers even when the contract is frozen, which can be exploited to block token transfers.
Similar to the 'transfer' function, the 'transferFrom' function does not check if the contract is frozen, allowing transfers even when the contract is frozen.
The 'approve' function does not check if the contract is frozen, allowing approvals even when the contract is frozen, which can be exploited to block token approvals.
The 'migrate' function does not check if the caller is the migration agent, allowing any user to migrate tokens, which can be exploited to migrate tokens from other users.
